sloka: न एतत् औपयिकम् राम यद् इदम् परितप्यसे ।विषादयसि सीताम् च माम् चैव पुरुष ऋषभ ॥२-५३-३०॥
transliteration: na etat aupayikam rāma yad idam paritapyase ।viṣādayasi sītām ca mām caiva puruṣa ṛṣabha ॥2-53-30॥

translations.english: This is not the way you should lament, O Rama. O foremost of men, by doing so you are disheartening me and Sita as well.
